items.title_cn: 中国首个面向全球与深空的太空计算基础设施“太空之弦”计算星座发布，G1 卫星预计明年发射
items.title_en: China's first global and deep-space computing infrastructure "Space String" constellation released, G1 satellite expected next year
items.title_original: 中国首个面向全球与深空的太空计算基础设施“太空之弦”计算星座发布，G1 卫星预计明年发射
items.what_happened: 据东方星链昨晚分享，其于 9 月 25 日联合地卫二发布了“太空之弦”计算星座——中国首个面向全球与深空的太空计算基础设施。东方星链负责总体设计与运营，地卫二提供 AI 能力支持并拓展国际市场。星座计划采用「业务层」与「计算层」协同架构：业务层计划部署 720+ 颗数据星，计算层计划在晨昏轨道分层部署 360+ 颗算力星，两层之间通过星间激光链路连接。规划以 G1 验证星、G2 标准星和 G3 旗舰星分阶段推进，G1 卫星预计于 2027 年第四季度发射。
items.what_happened_en: Dongfang Starlink and EarthTV jointly released the "Space String" computing constellation on Sept. 25, described as China's first space computing infrastructure for global and deep-space use. Dongfang Starlink handles overall design and operations, while EarthTV provides AI support and expands international markets. The plan uses a business layer with 720+ data satellites and a computing layer with 360+ compute satellites in dawn-dusk orbits, linked by inter-satellite laser links. It will advance in stages with G1 verification, G2 standard, and G3 flagship satellites; G1 is expected to launch in Q4 2027.
items.why_it_matters: 这是中国首个面向全球与深空的太空计算基础设施，并分阶段推进。
items.why_it_matters_en: It is China's first space computing infrastructure for global and deep-space use, advanced in stages.

items.title_cn: Cloudflare 如何修复 Containers 中的跨租户数据暴露漏洞
items.title_en: How Cloudflare addressed a cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability in Containers
items.title_original: How Cloudflare addressed a cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability in Containers
items.what_happened: 2026 年 9 月 4 日，来自 Accomplish 的安全研究员 Oren Yomtov 通过 Cloudflare 漏洞赏金计划负责任地报告了影响 Cloudflare Containers 和 Cloudflare Sandboxes 的漏洞。研究人员证明，拥有 Workers Paid 账户的客户可恢复同一主机上 Containers 先前使用的残留磁盘块。该技术无法针对特定客户、工作负载、主机或数据，且残留数据不保证存在。Cloudflare 已完全修复该漏洞，且没有证据表明客户数据遭到泄露。
items.what_happened_en: On Sept. 4, 2026, Oren Yomtov, a security researcher from Accomplish, responsibly reported a vulnerability affecting Cloudflare Containers and Cloudflare Sandboxes through Cloudflare's bug bounty program. Researchers showed that a customer with a Workers Paid account could recover residual disk blocks previously used by Containers on the same host. The technique could not target a particular customer, workload, host, or data, and residual data was not guaranteed to be present. Cloudflare fully remediated the vulnerability and has no evidence that customer data has been compromised.
items.why_it_matters: 它凸显了多租户云基础设施中的跨租户数据暴露风险。
items.why_it_matters_en: It highlights cross-tenant data exposure risk in multi-tenant cloud infrastructure.

items.title_cn: 使用 LFM2.5-VL-DSpark 加速视觉语言模型
items.what_happened: LiquidAI 发布了面向其视觉语言模型 LFM2.5-VL-3B 的实验性 DSpark 草稿模型。它增加了一条推测解码路径，以极小的内存占用增加换取更大的速度提升，且不改变输出质量。解码加速最高 3.13 倍（设备端）和 2.66 倍（H100），端到端增益最高 2.62 倍和 2.27 倍。草稿模型增加 280M 参数，占 3B 目标模型的 8.9%，首日支持 llama.cpp、MLX-VLM 和 SGLang。
items.what_happened_en: LiquidAI released an experimental DSpark draft model for its vision-language model LFM2.5-VL-3B. It adds a speculative decoding path that trades a minimal increase in memory footprint for a larger speedup without changing output quality. It reports decode speedups up to 3.13x on device and 2.66x on an H100, with end-to-end gains up to 2.62x and 2.27x. The drafter adds 280M parameters, 8.9% on top of the 3B target, with day-one support for llama.cpp, MLX-VLM, and SGLang.
items.why_it_matters: 在不改变输出质量的前提下显著加速视觉语言模型推理。
items.why_it_matters_en: It significantly speeds up vision-language model inference without changing output quality.
